categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yunyong Electronics and Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on industrial internet information security products and industrial IoT products, including industrial information security, new energy, information technology innovation (Xinchuang), and intelligent archive integrated management. The company serves sectors such as power, energy, finance, transportation, and military. Key product lines include industrial information security devices, intelligent archive cabinets, and control systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages embedded technology platforms based on RISC architectures (PowerPC, ARM, MIPS, LoongArch) combined with Linux operating systems. Core technologies include trusted computing, cryptographic technology, zero-trust security, industrial communication protocol proxy, microgrid energy management, physical isolation, firewall acceleration engines, VPN core engines, endpoint security detection and response, and IoT sensing technologies. Production involves design, SMT assembly, programming, testing, and quality control with a focus on customized and modular product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are industrial internet technology service providers and equipment suppliers who integrate and resell to end users in power, energy, finance, transportation, and government sectors. Major clients include State Grid Corporation, Southern Power Grid, and leading power industry companies such as Guodian Nari and XJ Electric. The company also serves emerging markets in new energy, digital archives, and Xinchuang (information technology innovation) sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant business in the East China, North China, Central China, Southwest, South China, Northwest, and Northeast regions. Key deployment provinces include Gansu, Hebei, Ningxia, Henan, and Xinjiang. The headquarters and main production base are in Taizhou, Jiangsu Province, with subsidiaries and sales centers in Beijing, Zhengzhou, Nanjing, Chengdu, and other cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunyong Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial internet and information security supply chain. It develops and manufactures embedded hardware and software products, integrating core technologies and providing customized solutions to system integrators and end users. The company collaborates closely with upstream chip manufacturers and software providers but focuses on product development, manufacturing, and direct sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in embedded technology platforms, trusted computing, cryptographic security, zero-trust architecture, industrial IoT, and new energy management systems. It emphasizes accelerating productization of key technologies, expanding the cloud-edge-end collaborative ecosystem, and enhancing product modularity and customization. Strategic R&D projects include development of domestic CPU-based platforms (Loongson, Feiteng, Rockchip), microgrid energy management, digital archives, and intelligent power distribution security. The company also focuses on Xinchuang industry development and aims to deepen cooperation with core domestic chip and OS providers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of integrated hardware and software products, including industrial information security devices, intelligent archive cabinets, and control systems. Sales are mainly conducted via bidding and commercial negotiations with industrial internet technology service providers and equipment integrators. The company’s revenue is project-based with customized product development and relatively long project cycles.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yunyong Technology is positioned as a key domestic supplier in the industrial information security and power industry sectors, recognized for its embedded technology platform and trusted computing capabilities. It competes with other domestic industrial internet and security companies, including Guodian Nari, Dongfang Electronics, XJ Electric, and other security technology firms. The company has established strategic partnerships with leading domestic chip manufacturers (Loongson, Feiteng) and OS providers (Kylin) to strengthen its competitive edge in the Xinchuang market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 296.98 million, a 5.18% increase year-over-year, but a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 35.09 million. R&D expenses accounted for 22.29% of revenue. Total assets were about RMB 1.02 billion, with net assets of RMB 911.96 million. The company’s cash flow from operating activities turned positive at RMB 39.74 million. Despite losses, the company maintains stable business operations and continues investing heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunyong Technology emphasizes its comprehensive embedded technology platform supporting multiple domestic CPU architectures and Linux-based systems, enabling high reliability, security, and customization for industrial internet applications. Its products integrate trusted computing, cryptographic security, zero-trust architecture, and industrial protocol compatibility, tailored for critical infrastructure such as power grids and new energy systems. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, strategic partnerships with domestic chip and OS providers, and modular product design enable rapid response to market demands and support national policies on information technology innovation and security.
